# VorTex

> A pure-Java Android floating-panel UI study (Bingxi / 冰昔 style). No XML layouts, no dependencies. Every screen is built in code, with a DSL-driven 12-category overlay menu.

Project: https://github.com/lianqlou114514-blip/VorTex
Site: https://lianqlou114514-blip.github.io/VorTex/
Signed APK: https://github.com/lianqlou114514-blip/VorTex/blob/main/releases/VorTex-1.0.apk
Release: https://github.com/lianqlou114514-blip/VorTex/releases/tag/v1.0
Sitemap: https://lianqlou114514-blip.github.io/VorTex/sitemap.xml

## Key facts

- Package: com.vortex.tool · Java 17 · minSdk 26 / targetSdk 34 · v1.0
- Floating ball 39dp morphs into 357x263dp panel in 300ms (ValueAnimator)
- DslConfig.DSL_TEXT is parsed at runtime into 12 menu categories
- State via SharedPreferences; downloads are simulated; zero runtime network calls
- Signed with APK Signature Scheme v2 + v3
